paragraphs: I’m a software engineer and MSc Automotive Software Engineering student at TU Chemnitz, based in Chemnitz, Germany.

My professional experience spans C++, computer vision, machine learning, hardware-oriented desktop software, backend development, and requirements engineering. At Frontier Semiconductor Metrology, my R&D work included 3D height-data image stitching, OpenCV pattern recognition, wafer mapping, and position-based autofocus compensation.

I enjoy algorithms, object-oriented and modular design, and technical problem-solving. I’ve solved 700+ programming problems and earned two first-place finishes in Intra-AUST programming contests. I’m highly comfortable with Linux/Unix systems and use Fedora daily.
My current interests include cross-platform C++, embedded systems, CMake, multimodal AI, and real-time interaction.
